links.outcome: Overall correctness of prompt-tuned chatbots versus base ChatGPT on real clinic sexual health queries
links.effect: Alice 85.2% (95% CI 82.1%-88.0%), Azure 69.3% (65.3%-73.0%), ChatGPT 64.8% (60.7%-68.7%); prompt-tuned outperformed base ChatGPT across all measures.
links.quote: Prompt-tuned chatbots outperformed the base ChatGPT across all measures.

links.outcome: Chatbot performance compared with nurse responses on the same sexual health questions
links.effect: Chatbots compared with human clinicians (nurses) by blinded expert panel; chatbots showed potential as adjuncts but all were susceptible to generating incorrect information.
links.quote: However, all AI chatbots showed susceptibility to generating incorrect information.

unlisted_practices: Prompt-tuning general LLMs with clinic-specific information to improve accuracy and safety
